distribution: Ningming, Guangxi; Mount Meihua and Mount Daiyun, Fujian.
soldier: Body medium-sized. Head and antennae yellow, mandibles reddish brown, labrum white; thoracic tergites and legs pale yellow, abdomen pale white. Head with sparse long hairs, those around the frontal gland aperture on the frons more numerous; labrum usually with 6–8 long setae; the anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum also with many long hairs; postmentum sparsely hairy, with only a few long and short hairs at the anterior end. Head rectangular, longer than wide, the sides parallel; head suture distinct, not reaching the mid-point of the head, in profile slightly depressed from the suture to the middle of the posterior margin. Fontanelle at the centre of the frons, distinctly depressed from the fontanelle to the postclypeus, appearing in profile as a longitudinal groove. Labrum rectangular, inclined to the right, the anterior margin concave, the two lateral corners projecting as points. Mandibles asymmetrical, the left slightly twisted and hooked at the tip, the right rather straight with a slight hook at the tip. Anterior part of the postmentum rather broad, the narrowest part of the waist near the middle and slightly behind it. Antennae 14 segments, the fourth rather short. Middle of the anterior margin of the pronotum slightly concave, the posterior margin without a distinct incision. Apical spur arrangement 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented.
